_comment: Game Review 2.0 findability constants. ALL PLACEHOLDERS (spec 3.3 Step 5) fit in Phase 3 calibration against the Lichess puzzle DB + a uniform quiet holdout. Refitting rewrites this file, never code.

tau_volatility._comment: Phase 4: tau = f(volatility). enabled=false keeps constant tau (Phases 0-3). tau_min/tau_max are placeholders fit in Phase 3.

_rating_grid_comment: MEASURED, do not widen. Maia-3 conditions on raw Elo 600-2600 and the obvious move was to widen the grid to match. Against 72 stratified Lichess puzzles (seed 7, line mode, Maia-3) the shipped score_mode='mean_ca' gets *worse* as the grid widens: |r(score,puzzle rating)| = 0.603 at 1100-2000, 0.594 at 1000-2200, 0.591 at 900-2300, 0.577 at 600-2600, and 0.602 at 1200-1950. Widening only helps the unused r_find-crossing scoring (0.484 -> 0.508), because averaging C_A over ratings nobody in the sample plays at compresses easy and hard positions together.
